functional_goal: Add a deterministic bounded mathematical research-state layer that derives the current dependency/obstruction picture from existing append-only workflow records and gives the web model one transparent advisory next action without changing workflow authority or verified .tex publication semantics.

seven_deliveries.name: governance_baseline_frozen_contracts
seven_deliveries.goal: Approve scope, record the synchronized baseline, freeze complexity budgets and protocol-3 research contract fixtures, and make the constraints machine-checkable.

seven_deliveries.name: pure_types_and_graph_algorithms
seven_deliveries.goal: Implement pure deterministic research types, dependency graph construction, cycle detection, reachability, frontier and digest with exhaustive unit/property tests.

seven_deliveries.name: normalized_append_only_research_records
seven_deliveries.goal: Normalize existing plans, screenings, branches, failures, replans, retrieval and verifier findings into existing logical channels and run projection in read-only shadow.

seven_deliveries.name: protocol_three_research_contracts
seven_deliveries.goal: Enable structured protocol-3 research fields for new runs while protocol-1/2 behavior and the generic rethlas_step envelope remain compatible.

seven_deliveries.name: bounded_advisory_context
seven_deliveries.goal: Expose a bounded obstruction-centered quotient and one deterministic advisory action without giving advice any authority.

seven_deliveries.name: paired_web_driven_mathematical_evaluation
seven_deliveries.goal: Compare protocol 2 and 3 on a frozen real-use corpus with normal web research, workspace Bash/CAS and independent evaluation of final verified .tex outputs.

seven_deliveries.name: cutover_release_and_final_receipt
seven_deliveries.goal: Make protocol 3 the default only after all engineering and mathematical gates pass, prove rollback on copied state, qualify the release and complete the final receipt.

recording_rules.runtime_records: Server-normalized append-only records contain concise mathematical conclusions, typed methods/obstructions/evidence and server-issued identity/order facts; they never contain raw web conversation transcripts or private reasoning traces.
recording_rules.engineering_receipts: Every delivery records before/after commit, changed files, graph changes, commands, exit codes, evidence hashes, failures, repairs, rollback and pending checks before it is accepted.
recording_rules.failure_policy: Failed attempts and rejected evidence are retained and classified rather than erased.
recording_rules.final_delivery: The only final mathematical artifact remains proof_verified.tex through the existing LaTeX, verifier, permit and finalizer path.

A0.required: Build, format, Clippy, tests, graph/governance validators, MTM-009 contract validator and diff checks.
A0.evidence: The complete Rust workspace passes format, warnings-denied Clippy, all-target tests, MTM-009 contract validation, migration/engineering graph validation and diff hygiene after bounded advisory-context integration.

A1.required: Protocol-1/2 frozen compatibility plus protocol-3 research-contract golden fixtures.
A1.evidence: The 82-checkpoint MTM-006 workflow differential retains zero mismatches and frozen SHA-256 def4f7abd3878638ff84952ce2632480eb427649a83868660087c97790de10b0; protocol-3 structured plans, events, screening, branch/failure/replan records and a complete proof_verified.tex path pass strict unit and end-to-end tests.

A2.required: Read-only deterministic shadow projection before model-facing exposure.
A2.evidence: Protocol-2 history is normalized and projected only through the owner-authorized research_state_shadow diagnostic; repeated and eight-way concurrent projections are byte-identical and leave the complete disposable state tree unchanged.

A3.required: Retry/crash/concurrency, identity, capability, branch/verifier firewall and finalizer non-regression.
A3.evidence: Owner mismatch is denied, forged reference/node data cannot influence the graph, malformed collections fail closed, the bounded view is exposed only to protocol-3 Generator/Repair roles, verifier findings enter only Repair-normalized context, Verifier/Branch/Assembler never receive the view, advice is not a precondition, and all existing capability/verifier/finalizer tests pass.

A4.required: Real web-driven paired mathematical evaluation with normal research/workspace tools and verified .tex outputs.
A4.evidence: The eight-case paired corpus, balanced AB/BA order, predeclared metrics, blind scoring contract and deterministic release gate are frozen; no real web treatment result is recorded yet.

A5.required: Task-envelope, projection latency, RSS, writes, replay and shutdown non-regression.
A5.evidence: The same current Rust release was run under explicit protocol 2 and protocol 3 through the same full workflow to DirectProving; 40 repeated task retrievals per treatment passed all eight bounded non-regression checks in mtm009-research-resource.json. This is explicitly not a performance claim.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first global dependency interpretation did not explicitly distinguish alternative plan routes and could have encouraged a future normalizer to model all plan goals as conjunctive target dependencies.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Added plan-local terminal-goal inference and independent route solved/blocker/invalid/frontier projections, plus a regression proving that one refuted plan does not invalidate another solved plan.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first legacy shadow normalizer accepted any reference_id written into the generation event channel and attached an unknown-node counterexample to the target, which could have distorted future advice despite the layer being non-authoritative.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Cross-check retrieval IDs against the authoritative reference registry, require a recognized canonical node and a meaningful non-empty witness before refutation, and add forged-ID, unknown-node and empty-witness regressions.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: Top-level channels were bounded, but nested plan, screening, branch and retrieval arrays were not all bounded; the original warning collector could also emit one detail beyond its declared maximum when adding the truncation marker.
recorded_failures_and_repairs.repair: Added hard limits to every normalized nested array, bounded retrieval evidence independently from novelty counts, reserved one warning slot for the truncation marker, and applied UTF-8-safe location/message truncation with adversarial tests.

recorded_failures_and_repairs.failure: The first copied-state rollback probe registered a fresh OAuth client after restart and correctly received RUN_OWNER_MISMATCH; the second reused the original token on a different port and correctly received OAUTH_UNAUTHORIZED because the token issuer changed.
